observations: Single photo shows a green scooter/moped with yellow-trimmed headlight assembly, photographed close-up from the front.
A white paper tag/label hangs from near the handlebar; text on it is not legible.
Background shows a compound wall, razor wire, and a gate, consistent with Rivers State outdoor setting.
No brand name, model number, or VIN/plate is visible anywhere in the frame.
No view of the full body, seat, tires, dashboard/instrument cluster, or battery compartment.
A watermark 'CHINEDUS' overlays the image; this is the uploader's mark, not product information.

claims.evidence: Only a tight front-headlight shot is given; no wide shot of body panels, seat, or undercarriage to confirm cleanliness or lack of damage.

claims.claim: Battery ran down, new owner will replace the batteries
claims.evidence: This is a seller statement about internal electrical condition; cannot be confirmed or denied from a photo. Functionally it means the unit is not currently demonstrated to power on.
No video or photo showing the remote or the starter engaging; since the battery is stated dead, this feature cannot be demonstrated at all right now.

risks.risk: Scooter may not power on at all beyond the stated battery issue (e.g., controller, motor, or wiring fault).
risks.proof: Video of seller connecting a charged battery and the scooter powering on, dashboard lighting, and motor turning over or wheel spinning.

risks.risk: Unknown make/model means unknown battery type, voltage, and replacement cost, which affects value heavily.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the frame data plate/sticker or battery compartment label showing brand, model, and voltage.
risks.if_unproven: priced at low end for unidentified generic e-scooter

risks.risk: Body condition (scratches, dents, cracked plastics) cannot be judged from a single close-up headlight shot.
risks.proof: Full 360° photos: front, rear, both sides, seat opened, and underside near footboard.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible wear consistent with 'used', not 'like new'

risks.risk: Tire condition and wheel/rim damage unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires' tread and rims.

risks.risk: No proof of ownership or ability to produce a working unit for buyer inspection before payment.
risks.proof: Photo of seller holding a dated note with the buyer's name, plus any purchase receipt or proof of ownership.
risks.if_unproven: priced with ownership/scam risk factored as a discount, not a stop

proof_requests: Photo of the frame's ID/data plate or any sticker showing brand and model.
Video of the scooter being connected to a charged/jump battery and powering on, including dashboard and motor response.
Full exterior photos: front, rear, left side, right side, seat opened to show battery compartment.
Close-up photos of both tires and rims.
A dated proof-of-ownership or seller-with-note photo for fraud screening.
response.reason: The item is identifiable only by type (an electric scooter/moped) since no brand or model is legible in the single photo provided; given the seller's own admission that the battery is dead and no power-on demonstration exists, it must be priced at worst case as a non-functional unit of unverified brand and condition.
